stances.summary: Criticizes polling firms for releasing fake polls
stances.quote: I guarantee this isn’t the only firm releasing fake polls this year.

stances.summary: Points out polling and prediction market failures in Democratic primary races
stances.quote: Another week, another Dem primary where the polls, prediction markets, and talking heads got it wrong. Given that this happened just a week ago in MI, one would think we might have learned. Hong could still win in WI, but the certainty in the outcome in this race was misplaced.

stances.summary: Suggests candidate Hong faces difficult path to victory
stances.quote: Fwiw, it looks like about 80% of the precincts in Madison have reported already, so Hong is going to need to find more votes somewhere else.

stances.summary: Criticizes polling accuracy and premature race declarations
stances.quote:
The average polling error in MI looks to be double digits. Some thoughts on this:

- I hope those pollsters share some introspection as to how they missed so badly. 

- A lot of very smart people on this site acted like this race was decided a week ago.

stances.summary: Calls prediction markets unreliable and prone to manipulation
stances.quote: - I never again want to see reporting on prediction markets as if they are a useful tool for gauging where races stand. They're easily manipulated and are going to magnify any polling error. It's crazy that credible news outlets rely on them as such.

stances.summary: Questions whether primary polling underperformance will repeat in general election
stances.quote: - We need to win this Senate race. If AES does pull this out, an important immediate question is if he underperformed his primary polling so badly, will he do the same in the general election tests in those same polls? I don't think so, but it's an important question.

stances.summary: Appreciates effective campaign advertising
stances.quote: I'm not from Michigan, so the fact that there is no such place as South Detroit doesn't bother me, but this is a good ad.

stances.summary: Questions accuracy of late polling showing El-Sayed winning by large margin
stances.quote: Still a lot of votes to be counted in Michigan (I'm not staying up for it), but it seems likely that the flood of late polls showing El-Sayed winning by a strong double digit margin are going to be pretty far off.

stances.summary: Primary polls unreliable; candidate has viable path to victory
stances.quote: I don't know who's going to win this race (I just know that we need to help them win in Nov) but the idea that any pollster would have a client down 14 pts in a primary poll and tell them "there's no path to victory" is silly. Primary polls are far less reliable due to turnout.

stances.summary: Calls for candidate withdrawal from race
stances.quote: Waiting another minute to get out of this race is wildly irresponsible. He is owed nothing by anyone and needs to get out of the way.

stances.summary: Opposes voter suppression legislation
stances.quote: If the options are truly either we have to listen to you lie about voter fraud or let you pass a voter suppression bill, then fine - keep on lying.

stances.summary: Supports local election candidate
stances.quote: I'm proud of my kid, working hard to help elect @VAtterbeary, who won impressively last night. And she provided some great quotes in an interview with the Baltimore Banner while working at the polls! thebanner.com/politics-power…

stances.summary: Criticizes media reliance on prediction markets as unreliable reporting
stances.quote: Stop reporting on prediction markets. I beg of you. They had Hong as an absolute sure thing until an hour ago. It's ill informed vibes and reporters should treat it as such.

stances.summary: Suggests media will use low-quality polls to create false Democratic crisis narrative
stances.quote:
Cue the parade of polling firms you've never heard of before to produce a flood of zero transparency surveys. 

(just kidding, they won't do that until after Labor Day, to create a narrative of the Dems blowing it)

stances.summary: Fact-checks misleading claims about pool color
stances.quote: Yes, the Democrats will tell you there's green algae. As will your eyes, because the pool you just said was painted "American flag blue" is more green than the grass that surrounds it.

stances.summary: Criticizes commentator for factual errors
stances.quote: One would think this guy would do a quick google before confidently stating that voters needed an excuse to cast a vote by mail “pretty much everywhere” before 10 years ago.

stances.summary: Critiques Trump's intervention in personnel decisions
stances.quote: I mean... had Trump not gotten Balogun reinstated, at least we would have an excuse for losing and could have spent the next 4 years blissfully overconfident.

stances.summary: Criticizes wasteful spending on reflecting pool color changes
stances.quote: Personally, I don't really care what color the reflecting pool is... the blue looks as good as the green. I do care that we spent a lot of money to make it blue, and are spending more money now that it is green. But there are also more important things to focus on.

stances.summary: Questions practicality of White House security protocols for events
stances.quote: I genuinely don't understand how this is supposed to work. It's not like the White House is a sports stadium where fans can seek cover under the stands during a thunderstorm. I assume they'd have to empty the WH grounds and then face rescreening the fans, which would take a long

stances.summary: Criticizes asymmetric media accountability for Democrats versus Republicans
stances.quote: The last few weeks it seems every Democrat has been forced to comment on Hasan Piker (a streamer, not even a member of the Dem Party). Yet I'd bet not a single Republican candidate will have to answer for Trump's racism, despite him being a leader of the party.

stances.summary: Criticizes FBI for distraction from core mission by 2020 voter fraud investigations
stances.quote: Good thing we have very experienced and competent leadership at the FBI and they totally have not been distracted by their snipe hunt looking for voter fraud from 2020.

stances.summary: Calls for official removal from position
stances.quote: Platner needs to go, and should have gone a long time ago.

stances.summary: Defends rooting for Team USA despite Trump admin FIFA appeal success
stances.quote: I genuinely don't get rooting against the US tonight, because of the Trump administration's successful appeal. I don't know enough about FIFA's rules to know if this decision was defensible, but I do know that I'm not going to blame Team USA for FIFA's mistake (if they made one).

stances.summary: Criticizes excessive politicization of everyday life as exhausting
stances.quote: I've worked in politics all of my adult life. I consume a lot of political info. Yet, even I find this sort of thing where people try to make literally everything in their life political just exhausting.
